# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v1.1.0

这一版本进一步收紧项目工作流，并让每日 Checklist、生活节律填写和每周执行切片在实际使用中更可靠、更容易检查。

## 主要更新

- 每日 Checklist 的勾选进度和周末“训练日／休息日”选择改为按日期持久保存。切换视图、重启插件或同步到其他设备后仍可恢复。
- “今日记录”增加阶段完整度和待补检查。仍可自由跳跃填写，同时能一眼识别未开始、待补、完成或无需检查的阶段，并直接跳转到遗漏字段。
- 午饭后专业学习先选择“没有／有”，只有确有安排时才显示书目、主题、计划与完成记录。
- 移除重复的右上角添加按钮、收件箱导航和独立收件箱页面。新条目统一从明确分类的入口创建并默认进入“待开始”，旧收件箱状态数据仍可在“全部”中查看和调整。
- 整理页分别列出“重点投入”的长期领域和“进行中”的顶层项目，清楚区分近期重视什么与正在做什么。
- 每周视图恢复执行切片的完成操作：今天可完成或放弃，过去的未完成切片可补记完成，未来切片可提前完成并自动移到今天。
- 营养管理中的“每日目标”和“常用模板”改为独立卡片；“当日已吃”使用独立滚动区，并根据桌面或平板空间调整高度。

## 升级说明

本版本兼容现有工作项、生活节律、Checklist 和营养数据，不需要手动迁移。旧版已经因插件重启而丢失的 Checklist 勾选无法恢复，但升级后产生的新勾选会写入 `checklist.json`，并继续使用三份轮换备份和写后复核。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v1.1.0

This release tightens the project workflow and makes Daily Checklist progress, Life Rhythm completion review, and weekly execution slices more reliable in everyday use.

## Highlights

- Daily Checklist checks and weekend Training/Rest choices are now persisted by date. They survive view changes, plugin restarts, and synchronization to another device.
- Today's Record now shows stage completion and a missing-fields review. Non-linear entry remains available, while incomplete stages and omitted key fields are immediately visible and directly accessible.
- Professional study after lunch begins with a No/Yes decision and shows book, topic, plan, and result fields only when study is actually planned.
- Removed the redundant header Add button, Inbox navigation, and standalone Inbox page. New items now come from typed creation entry points and default to Ready; legacy Inbox-status items remain available in All.
- Review separately lists Focused long-term areas and Ongoing top-level projects, clearly distinguishing what matters now from what is actively being done.
- Week restores execution-slice completion actions: today's slices can be completed or abandoned, missed past slices can be corrected as completed, and future slices can be completed early by moving them to today.
- Nutrition management now separates Daily Goals and Food Templates into distinct cards. Today's Intake has its own scrollable area that adapts its height to desktop and tablet layouts.

## Upgrade notes

Existing work-item, Life Rhythm, Checklist, and nutrition data remain compatible, with no manual migration required. Checklist checks already lost after a restart in an older version cannot be recovered, but new checks are written to `checklist.json` with the existing three rotating backups and read-after-write verification.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
